purpose: Define which audio element families SNOOZE needs for the ToC-first personalized Sleep, Calm, and Focus product before producing more candidate audio.
productGoal: A consumer describes the sound they need and receives a fitting, immediately playable, refinable, saveable, and reliably replayable personalized soundscape.

scope.primaryUse: compose personalized soundscapes from approved reusable ingredients
scope.notPrimaryUse: generate one fixed finished song per request

hardBusinessRules: Do not count a finished song as a foundational element.
Do not count a mixed Lyria clip as an independent instrument or stem unless the single-target identity passes human review.
Do not let generic broadband noise become the main product identity.
Do not use human voice, singing, chanting, choir, or human-like vocal texture in Voice-free Beta.
Do not use drums, percussion, clear beat, groove, or pulse for Sleep and Calm defaults.
Do not make medical, healing, brainwave, heart-rate, cure, or guaranteed-outcome claims.
Every approved element needs source identity, role, gain range, loop or one-shot behavior, incompatibility notes, and QA state.

elementFamilies.businessRole: Give the composition engine real instruments it can play from notes instead of reusing fixed recordings.
notAllowedAsSource: separated other stem without clear identity
Lyria clip used as a piano sample

elementFamilies.businessRole: Create many different works from the same inventory by changing harmony, motifs, form, density, and seed.
notAllowedAsSource: single fixed melody reused for every user

elementFamilies.businessRole: Provide musical color when the user wants light music, meditation music, or gentle focus support.
allowedSources: commercial AI candidate after single-target review

elementFamilies.businessRole: Support user requests for concrete scenes such as rain, room, forest, wind, water, travel, or quiet indoor background.
allowedSources: commercial AI candidate after identity review
notAllowedAsSource: traffic-like foreground unless user requested traffic

elementFamilies.businessRole: Provide optional stable masking for users who explicitly want noise or need background smoothing, without becoming the whole product.
notAllowedAsSource: generic noise wall as default result

elementFamilies.businessRole: Add subtle tactile character so mixes do not feel sterile, while staying independently adjustable.
allowedSources: commercial AI candidate after single-texture review

elementFamilies.businessRole: Give sessions a beginning, ending, or rare cue without turning the soundscape into a song.
allowedSources: commercial AI candidate after one-shot review

elementFamilies.businessRole: Provide exact measurable signal layers when the product needs controllable tones, offsets, or noise parameters.
Calibrate quality, taste, and scenario fit; provide replayable content, but not count as composable foundation.
notAllowedAsSource: one fixed track for every user

defaultProductionOrder: Lock this business inventory contract before producing more sound.
Audit current inventory against each family and state.
Fill structured composition material and playable instrument gaps first.
Then produce or source music beds, environment beds, textures, and accents by family.
Build representative Recipe combinations only after elements pass family QA.
Promote only combinations that improve Sleep, Calm, and Focus distinctness and save-worthiness.
